## Angular Sortable Component

The [Kendo UI for Angular Sortable](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable) is a component for dragging and dropping an element within a list to a new location within that list while the rest of the items correspondingly reorder.

## Key Features

Among the many features which the Kendo UI for Angular Sortable delivers are:

* [Data Binding](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/binding)&mdash;You can bind the Sortable to an array of strings or objects, or utilize the built-in directive, which cuts down the repetitive boilerplate code and simplifies the handling of data operations.
* [Managing the Items](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/items)&mdash;You can choose to render Sortable items in their disabled state so that, if need be present, users will not be able to interact with them.
* [Templates](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/templates)&mdash;You can visually customize the content, color, structure, and the general look and feel of the Sortable by implementing templates in the component.
* [Accessibility](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/accessibility)&mdash;The Sortable is accessible for screen readers and supports WAI-ARIA attributes.
* [Globalization](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/globalization)&mdash;The Sortable supports globalization to ensure that it can fit well in any application, no matter what languages and locales need to be supported. Additionally, the Sortable supports rendering in a right-to-left (RTL) direction.
* [Keyboard Navigation](https://www.telerik.com/kendo-angular-ui/components/sortable/keyboard-navigation)&mdash;The Sortable supports a number of keyboard shortcuts which allows users to accomplish various commands.
